fresh-thyme-market-newport.chronic.1: You can pick up your order within the selected time frame. If you are going to arrive late or need to change your order, please contact the store directly. If the store has not heard from the customer by the end of the day, the order will be cancelled. Payment is not processed for cancelled orders.
fresh-thyme-market-newport.cognitive.3: Currently, pick-up times can be scheduled as far out as two weeks in advance. What if my desired timeslot is not showing? If the timeslot you desire is not available, this means that store already has the maximum amount of pickup orders during that timeframe. Please choose the next available timeslot.
fresh-thyme-market-newport.chronic.2: How will temperature-controlled products stay hot or cold? Temperature-controlled products are placed in temperature-controlled storage.
fresh-thyme-market-newport.cognitive.4: Can I purchase CBD products online? Not at this time. CBD products can only be purchased in-store. Can I purchase alcohol online? Not through pick-up at this time. Alcohol products can only be purchased in-store or through a delivery service provider like DoorDash, Instacart, or UberEats.
clermont-transportation-connection-dial-: Dial-A-Ride is a door to door public transit service. Passengers must call the Dispatch office and schedule a ride on a CTC bus. The service is open to any person in Clermont County. All buses are wheelchair accessible.
To schedule a ride, you can call UP TO 14 DAYS IN ADVANCE , trips are scheduled on a first come first serve basis. The scheduling office is open from 5:30 am to 6:30 pm Monday thru Friday.
Dispatch Phone Number 513-732-7433 – Press Option 2 to speak to Dispatcher
Dial-A-Ride service is available Monday thru Friday 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM (NOT SATURDAYS)
CTC will be CLOSED on the below days New Year’s Day Memorial Day Independence Day Labor Day Thanksgiving Day Christmas Day
In the event of severe weather, CTC may close it’s Dial-A-Ride service for safety if this happens information is submitted to all major broadcasting networks.

Passengers can be picked up anywhere in Clermont County and taken to any destination in Clermont County. If a passenger wishes to go outside Clermont County, CTC can drop them off at a METRO bus stop in Clermont County, but CTC will not leave the county.
The driver may help passengers on and off the bus and may help them secure their wheelchair, but under no circumstances will a driver enter a passenger’s home or business.
The bus may arrive 15min before or after the scheduled pick up or drop off time.
The bus will wait 5 min at the pickup location.
Passengers who have a service animal may bring it on the bus.
Passengers may bring up to 4 shopping bags on the bus, additional bags are $1.00 each.
Dial-A-Ride Fares All fares are for a one way trip Adult $4.75 Student ( 13+ with a student ID) $3.75 Persons with Disabilities* $2.35 Seniors* $2.35 Children (12 and under) $2.35
To receive this fare you must fill out a discount fare application with CTC (PDF) Exact change is required
If a passenger needs to call and cancel a ride, they must call CTC at least 2 hours in advance. If a passenger fails to call 2 hours in advance, they will receive a “ No Show .”
If a passenger does not cancel 2 hours in advance because of an “extreme situation,” they must call CTC. Cases will be handled in a case-by-case basis.
This policy is not applicable to Complimentary ADA Paratransit.
